# pitch_jitter: how far each pitch's spin axis is turned at random. f_700024ab18 (pitch spin setup) draws u in
# [-1, 1] and adds u x 22.5 deg to both the visible-break direction (+0xc4, f6) and the real spin axis (+0x118); the
# 22.5 is one constant (mov w8, #0x41b40000 at 0x700024ad38). An angle scatters a big break a lot and a small one
# barely. With real movement the 4-seam scattered 3.6 in sideways (SD within a pitcher's game; MLB 1.8 in), sweepers,
# curves and splitters 2.6-3.6 in (MLB 1.7-2.7); sliders, whose break is small, 0.9 in (MLB 1.9-2.1), which no angle
# fixes. 12.5 deg brings the big-break types to about MLB size.

set  pitch_jitter  MLB_PITCH_JITTER  0

# pitcher_shapes: each pitcher's pitches move like his own. The game has one movement per pitch type (its ratings only
# size curves, sliders, sweepers, changeups and splitters, and tilt sinkers, cutters, changeups and splitters a little).
# runtime/mlb/shapes.c writes two floats per pitch type to the patch page for the pitcher on the mound: a turn (deg, at
# +0x400 + 4 x type) toward his 2026 Statcast movement direction, else what his arm slot predicts; and a size (x, at
# +0x480 + 4 x type) to his own movement's (every type but the knuckleball; the type's without data), both moved by
# his movement rating as a percentile of MLB pitchers'; and, on a type the game sizes by rating, three rating terms
# A, B, C (+0x580 / +0x600 / +0x680 + 4 x type) that take the game's own rating curve out of the size
# (runtime/mlb/shapes_table.h, tools/make_shapes_table.py).
# Turn: f_7000247214 (pitch setup) reads the type's axis f2 (row +0x10, deg) and visible-break direction f6 (row +0x20)
# before it mirrors them for left-handers, and f_700024b7f8 reads f6 again for the types it adjusts; each load adds
# the turn. Free registers at the three: x9, x10, s16 (written later or dead, caller-saved). Every word but the first
# is new:
#   ldrb w9, [x19, #0x12]       39404a69   pitch type
#   adrp x10, <patch page>      @page:x10
#   add  x10, x10, w9, uxtw #2  8b29494a
#   ldr  s16, [x10, #0x400]     bd440150   the turn for this type
#   fadd s2, s2, s16            1e302842   (s0 at the third site: 1e302800)
# Size: f_700024ab18 builds the spin vector as the unit axis x pitch +0x10c (ldr s2 at 0x700024afcc); the load is
# multiplied by size x (A / q + B / (2 - q) + C), q = the pitch's movement-rating x speed factors (+0xcc, +0xd0),
# clamped to 0.5..1.5 (the Magnus force is linear in the spin vector). After the load the function only scales the
# axis by s2 and returns: x9, x10 and s16..s21 are free.
#   ldrb w9 / adrp x10 / add x10  as above
#   ldr  s16, [x10, #0x480]     bd448150   size
#   ldp  s17, s18, [x19, #0xcc] 2d59ca71   movement rating factor, speed factor
#   fmul s17, s17, s18          1e320a31   q
#   fmov s18, #0.5              1e2c1012
#   fmaxnm s17, s17, s18        1e326a31
#   fmov s18, #1.5              1e2f1012
#   fminnm s17, s17, s18        1e327a31   q in 0.5..1.5
#   fmov s18, #2.0              1e201012
#   fsub s18, s18, s17          1e313a52   2 - q
#   ldr  s19, [x10, #0x580]     bd458153   A
#   ldr  s20, [x10, #0x600]     bd460154   B
#   ldr  s21, [x10, #0x680]     bd468155   C
#   fdiv s19, s19, s17          1e311a73
#   fdiv s20, s20, s18          1e321a94
#   fadd s19, s19, s20          1e342a73
#   fadd s19, s19, s21          1e352a73
#   fmul s16, s16, s19          1e330a10
#   fmul s2, s2, s16            1e300842

# Flight length: break grows with the square of the flight, and the game's deliveries let go 52.9-55.9 ft from the
# plate (the animation's hand), real pitchers 59.08 ft - their extension (Ohtani's game delivery 55.1 ft against his
# real 52.2): over the same distance the movement above is his own, from the hand it was 5-12 % more. The flight step
# f_7001658448 (the path solve at release, f_7001666bc0, runs it too, so the aim still lands on the target) scales its
# Magnus force (spin x velocity) by s0 at 0x70016585f4; for a pitch (ball +0x2c5, the route's pitch flag: no wind) it
# is multiplied by N / d^2, d = this pitch's release (+0x410 / +0x418) to crossing (+0x420 / +0x428) distance, N =
# (59.08 - the delivery's real extension)^2 at page +0xc00 (runtime/mlb/shapes.c; 0 = off). Flag-free (a site may
# not set or read NZCV): k = N / d^2 clamped to 0.78..1.125, then 1 + pitch x min(N, 1) x (k - 1).
# x8 / x9 (set again before use), s4 / s5 (reloaded after), s16-s18 (written before any later read) are free.
#   fmul s0, s0, s4              1e240800   the game's Magnus scale
#   ldrb w8, [x19, #0x2c5]       394b1668   pitch flag (1 from the release to the plate; 0 once hit, and for throws)
#   ucvtf s18, w8                1e230112
#   adrp x9, <patch page>        @page:x9
#   ldr  s4, [x9, #0xc00]        bd4c0124   N
#   ldr s5 / s16 +0x420 / +0x410, fsub; ldr s16 / s17 +0x428 / +0x418, fsub; fmul, fmadd: s5 = d^2
#   fdiv s5, s4, s5              1e251885   k
#   fmov s16, #0.78125 / fmaxnm s5; fmov s16, #1.125 / fminnm s5; fmov s16, #1.0; fsub s5, s5, s16
#   fminnm s4, s4, s16           1e307884   min(N, 1): 0 when off
#   fmul s4, s4, s18             1e320884
#   fmadd s4, s4, s5, s16        1f054084   1 + ... x (k - 1)
#   fmul s0, s0, s4              1e240800

# release_extension: perceived velocity per delivery (moved from Real Pitch Speed, mods/pitch-types/extension/
# README.md). No code sites: runtime/mlb/extension.c multiplies the ball's playback multiplier and time scale at each
# pitch's release by (this flight / 54.6) x (52.67 / (59.08 - the delivery's real extension)) while this set is on.
set  release_extension  MLB_RELEASE_EXTENSION  0

# pitch_classes: each retyped pitch is the game type that fits the pitcher's real pitch (an arm-side cutter is a
# running fastball, a riding sinker a 2-seam, a Statcast sweeper a sweeper; tools/pitch_classes.py). No code sites:
# runtime/mlb/classes.c rewrites those slots' type and velocity rating (same mph) in the loaded roster while this set is
# on, and puts them back when it is switched off.
set  pitch_classes  MLB_PITCH_CLASSES  0

# pitch_usage: each pitcher's real pitch mix by batter side and count. f_70000cd760 (the CPU's pitch choice) loads the
# arsenal's 5 slot weights (arsenal +0x38..+0x48, set by slot position in f_7000245bb8) to [x29 - 0x5c .. - 0x4c] and
# later multiplies them by its count table per category. After the last store (0x70000cd874, mov x0, x19) the site
# replaces each with real x F + game x (1 - F): real = page +0x900 + 32 x block + 4 x slot, F = page +0x914 + 32 x
# block, block = 12 x side + 3 x balls + strikes (side: the batter's byte *(context + 0x40) + 0x10, x24 here; 0
# right-handed, 1 left-handed; balls and strikes: the count object *(context + 0x38) +0x8 / +0xc, x28 here; masked to
# 0..31). runtime/mlb/shapes.c writes the 24 blocks for the pitcher on the mound (runtime/mlb/usage_table.h,
# tools/make_usage_table.py: his 2026 shares at that side and count over the live count table); F = 0 keeps the game's
# weights. Free: x8 / x9 (reloaded right after), s16-s19 (written before any later read).
set  pitch_usage  MLB_PITCH_USAGE  0
site pitch_usage  main  cd874  aa1303e0  aa1303e0 39404309 12000129 52800188 1b087d29 b9400b88 0b080129 0b080529 b9400f88 0b080129 12001129 @page:x8 8b091508 bd491512 1e2e1013 1e323a73 bc5a43b0 bd490111 1e330a10 1f124230 bc1a43b0 bc5a83b0 bd490511 1e330a10 1f124230 bc1a83b0 bc5ac3b0 bd490911 1e330a10 1f124230 bc1ac3b0 bc5b03b0 bd490d11 1e330a10 1f124230 bc1b03b0 bc5b43b0 bd491111 1e330a10 1f124230 bc1b43b0   # slot weights

# Pitching++ rubber spot: each pitcher stands where he really does on the rubber (game 1.0.20, main module).
# runtime/mlb/rubber.c keeps page +0xe00 (right-handed path) and +0xe04 (left-handed path) at the spot of the pitcher
# on the mound: the ball of his pivot foot, ft from the rubber's centre, + toward first base (MLB Gameday 3D, 2026;
# mods/pitch-types/deliveries/gameday3d), or the game's -0.65 / +0.65 when he is not in its table.
set   rubber_spot  MLB_RUBBER_SPOT  0
# f_70002e4f54, the pitcher's start spot: fmov s1, w8 (left-handers' +0.65) -> adrp x8, page; ldr s1, [x8, #0xe04]
site  rubber_spot  main  2e50d4  1e270101  @page:x8  bd4e0501
# fmov s2, w8 (right-handers' -0.65) -> adrp x8, page; ldr s2, [x8, #0xe00] (x8 is reloaded at 0x70002e50f0)
site  rubber_spot  main  2e50e0  1e270102  @page:x8  bd4e0102
# the game's values until the runtime writes a pitcher's: -0.65 (0xbf266666), +0.65 (0x3f266666)
page  rubber_spot  e00  666626bf6666263f

# delivery_styles: every 2026 pitcher throws his own copy of the delivery he already has, its windup and stretch edited
# to his real 2026 release (the Pitching Animation Research chat; deliveries/ship/HANDOVER.md). No code sites: the
# copies are put in the game files by the file step (tools/deliveries_install.py), and runtime/mlb/styles.c points each
# pitcher's roster record at his copy while this set is on (back when switched off; off by itself without the files).
set  delivery_styles  MLB_DELIVERY_STYLES  0

# slide_steps: every 2026 pitcher throws his own slide step (made from his edited stretch; the Pitching Animation
# Research chat, deliveries/ship/HANDOVER.md) instead of the game's four shared ones. No code sites: the file step puts
# them in PITCHERSLIDE.XBN, and runtime/mlb/slidestep.c points the game's four slide-step clips at the pitcher on the
# mound's own while this set is on (the game's back when switched off; off by itself without the file). Needs
# delivery_styles on.
set  slide_steps  MLB_SLIDE_STEPS  0

# Real Pitch Speed: a faster pitch raises exit velocity at the real rate (code patch, recomp/patches.py).
# Generated by tools/make_patches.py --q 0.2 --neutral 87.5; do not edit by hand.
# Game 1.0.20, f_7001681314: EV x= remap(pitch speed, 75..100 mph -> 0.99..1.01) becomes
# EV x= remap(pitch speed, 50..111 mph -> 0.938017..1.038843): +0.200 mph of EV per pitch mph off a 121 mph swing,
# x1 at 87.5 mph like the game, x1.0207 at 100 (the game: x1.01), counted up to 111 mph.
